import sys
def solve():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not tokens: return
    n = int(tokens[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    low, high = 0, n - 1
    while low < high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if mid % 2 == 1: mid -= 1
        if arr[mid] == arr[mid + 1]: low = mid + 2
        else: high = mid
    print(arr[low])
